data.name: Delivery Derby
data.detailed_description:
In Delivery Derby, you work for an unconventional pizza chain that pits drivers against each other to deliver the same pizza. You will kick, run over, and commit other unforgivable acts upon your fellow drivers to gain any advantage you can.

Specialty Pizzas

Each kind of pizza has unique modifiers that can completely change how you drive and deliver it. Frozen pizzas freeze the ground beneath you and cause you to slide around. Hot potato pizzas cause you to crash if you hold them for too long. Spicy pizzas propel you to drive even faster, at the cost of maneuverability. No two deliveries are the same!

Moped-based Combat

There are also items scattered across the map you can use to reach players who are out of kicking distance. Explosives are fair game in Delivery Derby. You can drop bombs to neutralize drivers in hot pursuit. Or if you find yourself behind, launch a missile to send the pizza and the unfortunate soul who was carrying it airborne.

Other Features

  • 2-4 players in online or local split-screen play

  • A variety of unique maps

  • Character customization

data.short_description: Work for an unconventional pizza chain that pits drivers against each other to deliver the same pizza. You will kick, run over, and commit other unforgivable acts to your fellow drivers to gain any advantage you can. Test your delivery skills (and your friendships) in this chaotic multiplayer game!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86 32bit CPU with SSE2 support, x86 64bit CPU with SSE4.2 support, or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support, or Direct3D 12 support
  • Storage: 150 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2018
  • Processor: x86 32bit CPU with SSE2 support, x86 64bit CPU with SSE4.2 support, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
